Spray a heavy skillet with cooking spray.  Place over medium heat and cook vegetables until tender; remove vegetables and keep
warm.  Combine whole egg and egg whites.  Pour into skillet and scramble over medium heat until set.  Spoon onto plates.
Top with cooked vegetables and sprinkle with cheese.  Serve with salsa.  Yield: 2 servings
